segments.text: We first tried Point-of-Sale (POS) in 206. At the time, competition mattered because competitors moved online and took some market share.
The biggest issue was Power outages. Without steady power in Kano, costs kept rising.
Our sales changed after Point-of-Sale (POS)—we saw Faster order fulfillment within 8 months.
Policy-wise, Data protection shaped our move. We adjusted by Partnership with fintech.
Data helped; even a moving-average model gave us clearer demand patterns during New Year.
